name: Sapienza University of Rome
summary: Rome's large public university; eight English bachelor's from AI to Classics plus English-taught Medicine, Dentistry and Nursing.

ib.text: A diploma after 12 years of school; the IB Diploma waives the English certificate. Each degree asks for a test score (SAT, CEnT-S or a CISIA test) and a minimum school average.

programmes.name: Applied Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: Applied computing and artificial intelligence on a base of maths, physics and statistics, with third-year options, economics or law, and an internship.
programmes.ib: EU applicants do not use MoveIN: apply through the degree's own call with SAT (over 960) or English TOLC-I (18/50).
programmes.selectionNote: Needs a test score and a school average of at least 75/100 on Sapienza's scale. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Bioinformatics
programmes.about: Biochemistry, genetics, molecular biology, medicinal chemistry and computer science combined, ending with computational biology, machine learning and an internship.
programmes.ib: CEnT-S test (any score above zero) for pre-selection.
programmes.selectionNote: Pre-selection on CEnT-S and a school average of at least 75/100, then the degree's admission call. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Business Sciences
programmes.about: How modern businesses and financial systems work, across economics, management, finance and law, for consulting and management roles.
programmes.ib: SAT 960+ or CEnT-S 18/55 for pre-selection; a strong maths background is expected.
programmes.selectionNote: Pre-selection on a test score and a school average of at least 80/100, then the degree's admission call. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Economics and Finance
programmes.about: Economic and financial markets, statistics and forecasting, and the effects of public policy; the English path of a degree that also runs three Italian paths.
programmes.ib: SAT 960+ or CEnT-S for pre-selection; a strong maths background is expected.
programmes.selectionNote: Pre-selection on a test score and a school average of at least 80/100, then the degree's admission call. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Classics
programmes.about: Ancient Greek and Latin with archaeology, art history, law, philosophy and science, reading the Greek and Roman world as part of today's heritage.
programmes.ib: SAT or English TOLC-E / English Test HUM for pre-selection.
programmes.selectionNote: Pre-selection on a test score and a school average of at least 75/100. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Global Humanities
programmes.about: A flexible humanities and social science degree: history, anthropology, literature, media, law, human rights, migration and gender studies, and more.
programmes.ib: SAT or English Test HUM, plus an English certificate or a school letter that your IB was taught in English; CV and motivation are read.
programmes.selectionNote: A committee reads your grades (average 70/100+), English, CV and motivation; it may interview you. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Molecular Biology, Medicinal Chemistry and Computer Science for Pharmaceutical Applications
programmes.about: Molecular biology, medicinal chemistry and computer science together, aimed at how drugs and other active compounds are discovered and developed.
programmes.selectionNote: Pre-selection on a test score and a school average of at least 60/100, then the degree's admission call. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Sustainable Building Engineering
programmes.about: Civil engineering for sustainable buildings: low energy demand, passive design, recycled materials, longer building life and urban renewal, on the Rieti campus.
programmes.selectionNote: Pre-selection on a test score and a school average of at least 80/100, then the degree's admission call. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Nursing (Azienda Ospedaliera Sant'Andrea)
programmes.about: A three-year nursing degree taught in English, with clinical training at Rome's Sant'Andrea hospital.
programmes.ib: Admission test set by the degree's official call; not part of the MoveIN pre-selection.
programmes.selectionNote: Places filled by admission test score under the official call. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Medicine and Surgery "F"
programmes.about: Sapienza's six-year medical degree taught in English, leading to the degree in Medicine and Surgery.
programmes.ib: Admission test set by the official call; not part of the MoveIN pre-selection.
programmes.selectionNote: Places filled by admission test score under the official call. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Dentistry and Dental Prosthodontics
programmes.about: A six-year dentistry degree taught in English, covering oral and maxillofacial sciences and dental prosthetics.
programmes.ib: Admission test set by the official call; not part of the MoveIN pre-selection.
programmes.selectionNote: Places filled by admission test score under the official call. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Pre-selection is only step one: a pre-accepted applicant still has to take part in the degree's admission call, whose dates are set each year.
You may send at most two pre-selection applications per academic year.
The 2027-28 pre-selection has not opened yet; the 2026-27 round opened on 22 December 2025 and stayed open to EU applicants until 31 July 2026.
